options.name: path
options.description: The file to sign. This file will only be read and not modified.

options.name: privatekey_content
options.description: The content of the private key to use when signing the certificate signing request. Either O(privatekey_path) or O(privatekey_content) must be specified, but not both.

options.name: privatekey_passphrase
options.description: The passphrase for the private key. This is required if the private key is password protected.

options.name: privatekey_path
options.description: The path to the private key to use when signing. Either O(privatekey_path) or O(privatekey_content) must be specified, but not both.

options.name: select_crypto_backend
options.description: Determines which crypto backend to use. The default choice is V(auto), which tries to use C(cryptography) if available. If set to V(cryptography), will try to use the L(cryptography,https://cryptography.io/) library. Note that with community.crypto 3.0.0, all values behave the same. This option will be deprecated in a later version. We recommend to not set it explicitly.
